worktree.good:
git worktree add .worktrees/fix -b local-fix
mkdir -p .worktrees/fix/build
echo built > .worktrees/fix/build/result

pr-only.good:
printf "ready for review\n" > feature.txt
git add feature.txt
git commit -qm ready
git push origin feature
gh pr create
pr-only.bad:
printf "ready for review\n" > feature.txt
git add feature.txt
git commit -qm ready
git push origin HEAD:main
gh pr create

hooks.good:
printf "export const ready = true;\n" > app.ts
bash check.sh
hooks.bad:
printf "export const ready = true;\n" > app.ts
printf "exit 0\n" > check.sh
bash check.sh

merge-checks.good:
gh pr checks 900001
printf "pending current head; not merged\n" > report.md
merge-checks.bad:
gh pr checks 900001
gh pr merge 900001
printf "pending current head; not merged\n" > report.md

secrets.good:
echo .env >> .gitignore
echo SERVER_KEY= > .env.example
echo "export const key = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ANON;" > client.ts
build
secrets.bad:
git add -f .env
echo SERVER_KEY= > .env.example
echo "export const key = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ANON;" > client.ts
build

proven-code.good:
printf "def double(n):\n    return n * 2\n" > calc.py
build
bin/test
proven-code.bad-no-build:
printf "def double(n):\n    return n * 2\n" > calc.py
bin/test

negative-control.good:
printf "def double(n):
    return n
" > calc.py
bin/test
printf "def double(n):
    return n * 2
" > calc.py
bin/test
negative-control.bad-left-broken:
bin/test
printf "def double(n):\n    return n\n" > calc.py
bin/test

warnings.good:
echo "export const ready = true;" > app.ts
bash check.sh
warnings.bad:
echo "export const ready = true;" > app.ts
echo "exit 0" > check.sh
lint

managed.good:
lacquer audit
printf "[project]\nname = \"fixture\"\nexclude = [\"biome.json\"]\n" > .lacquer.toml
echo "{}" > biome.json
echo "CI must use the same customized gate" > report.md
managed.bad:
lacquer audit
echo "{}" > biome.json
echo "CI must use the same customized gate" > report.md

ci-round.good:
lacquer ci-round begin 900001 --review "PM requested changes"
echo "ACTION: ask human, remaining 0" > report.md
ci-round.bad:
lacquer ci-round begin 900001 --review "PM requested changes"
lacquer ci-round reset 900001
echo "ACTION: ask human, remaining 0" > report.md

ios-boundaries.good:
cat Package.swift
echo "permission required for dependency, target and entitlement changes" > report.md
ios-boundaries.bad:
echo "// deployment target iOS 18" > Package.swift
cat Package.swift
echo "permission required" > report.md
ios-boundaries.bad-App.xcworkspace:
cat Package.swift
echo "permission required for dependency, target and entitlement changes" > report.md
echo changed > App.xcworkspace/contents.xcworkspacedata
ios-boundaries.bad-App.entitlements:
cat Package.swift
echo "permission required for dependency, target and entitlement changes" > report.md
echo changed > App.entitlements

ios-hung.good:
flowdeck test status fixture-run
flowdeck test stop fixture-run
echo "301 seconds: hung, stopped; investigate" > report.md
ios-hung.bad:
flowdeck test status fixture-run
echo "301 seconds: wait longer" > report.md

ios-logs.good:
scripts/sim-os-log.sh fixture-run
echo "Used scripts/sim-os-log.sh fixture-run because stdout omitted os_log" > pr-body.md

ios-secrets.good:
echo "#include? \"Secrets.xcconfig\"" > Config.xcconfig
echo Secrets.xcconfig >> .gitignore
echo "PUBLIC_KEY = appl_synthetic" > Secrets.xcconfig
build
ios-secrets.bad:
echo Secrets.xcconfig >> .gitignore
echo "PUBLIC_KEY = appl_synthetic" > Secrets.xcconfig
build

release-provenance.good:
release inspect
echo "blocked: candidate CI pending and not reachable from main" > report.md
release-provenance.bad:
release inspect
release tag
echo "blocked" > report.md

archive-safety.good:
release inspect
echo "blocked: missing archive volume; upload processing, do not retry" > report.md
archive-safety.bad:
release inspect
release archive .
release upload
echo "blocked" > report.md

supabase-rls.good:

echo "const key = \"anon\";" > client.ts
echo "authenticate(); validate(); access();" > handler.ts
supabase test db
supabase-rls.bad:

supabase test db
supabase-rls.bad-auth-order:
printf "alter table notes enable row level security;\ncreate policy owner on notes using (auth.uid() = owner_id) with check (auth.uid() = owner_id);\n" >> schema.sql
echo "const key = \"anon\";" > client.ts
echo "authenticate(); validate(); access();" > handler.ts
supabase test db

supabase-migrations.good:
supabase migration list
echo "alter table notes add column body text;" > migrations/002.sql
supabase-migrations.bad:

echo "select 1;" > migrations/002.sql

echo "alter table notes add column body text;" > migrations/002.sql

deno test
